name: WorksheetInstance
label: Worksheet Instance
description: The Excel Worksheet object from which to retrieve the column name.

name: ColumnIndex
label: Column Index
description: The 1-based index of the column to retrieve the name from (e.g., 1 → first column).

name: ColumnName
label: Column Name
description: Returns the name of the column found in the first non-empty cell of the specified column.
